key_findings: **VERIFIED**: All 16 sibling Receivers' target classes are in the Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command::{System|Network}::*Receiver namespace family.

**DRAMATICALLY EXPANDED client-architecture 'The LuaControl hierarchy is the runtime surface' scope**: The Lua-bridge architecture covers 42 distinct Receiver classes (11 System + 31 Network), not just the 16 cataloged via the hybrid factories. The 16 are a SUBSET of the full Lua-bridge Receiver layer.

- System (11): UI/event-system Receivers including mount/vehicle (Chocobo/ChocoboGrade/Goobbue/VehicleGrade), trigger-box events (ExecutePushOnEnter/Leave/AttributeTypeEventEnter/Leave), sub-stat related (ChangeActorSubStatStatus/ChangeActorSubStatModeBorder), and debug (ExecuteDebugCommand).

- Network (31): network-arrival event Receivers including achievements (AchievementPoint/Title/Id/AchievedCount), stats (ChangeActorExtraStat/ChangeSystemStat/HateStatus), jobs (JobChange/JobQuestCompleteTriple), social/grand-company (GrandCompany), hamlet (HamletSupplyRanking/HamletDefenseScore), event conditions (SetCommandEventCondition/SetEmoteEventCondition/SetNoticeEventCondition/SetTalkEventCondition + 3 SetPushEvent variants), command (SetTargetTime/EntrustItem/EndClientOrderEvent/KickClientOrderEvent/StartServerOrderEventFunction/SendLog/SetEventStatus/SetDisplayName + UserData/SyncMemory).

**UserDataReceiver has 2 vftables** (multi-inheritance pattern at offsets 0 and ??). PRIMARY at 0x01057488, SECONDARY at 0x010574A4. Consistent with the StatusBase multi-inheritance pattern - some Receivers participate in MULTIPLE Lua-bridge interface segments simultaneously.
